name: Igor Pankin
headline: Finance Systems & ERP Product Lead
tagline: 20 years in financial ERP and FinTech: Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle Fusion Financials (Oracle ERP Cloud) implementation, custom development, SaaS/PaaS and integrations, delivery with P&L ownership — with AI agents in the delivery routine.

experience.description: Formal title: Lead Consultant. Delivery and P&L ownership for financial ERP projects and for in-house products taken to customers. Customers by request.
highlights: Delivered a portfolio of 6 projects (2014–2025): over €4.5M revenue and about €1.4M profit, ROI above 30%; own scope, budget, team and P&L

Led the two-year migration (2023–2025) of a large enterprise's financial ERP platform (applications, integrations, reports, data; hundreds of finance users) with no interruption to financial close; joint team of up to 20 consultants and 20–30 customer staff; project manager and functional architect (P2P, O2C)
Implemented 5 finance and tax areas for an industrial customer over 2021–2024 (cash management, fixed assets, Russian tax, EDI and bank-statement integration) and trained its key users
Supported 5 large pre-sales in 2025–2026 (telecom, chemicals, energy, mining): proposals, estimates, an IT-audit bid and sales materials
Automated 3 reporting streams for group finance in 2026 (IFRS, cash cycle, management P&L); developing AI-assisted workflows for ERP delivery

experience.description: Formal title: Senior Consultant (Lead Consultant from 2021). Project management and product ownership for Oracle ERP financial solutions as an Oracle Platinum partner.
highlights: Delivered an Oracle Fusion Financials (Oracle ERP Cloud) implementation for a major enterprise (three waves, go-live within 12 months, hypercare) alongside its international head-office team and a global integrator; product owner of a PaaS reporting service
Built a SaaS product from scratch as an extension of Oracle ERP and took it to customers
Developed and distributed the official Oracle localisation solution for Russia
Ran a multi-year PaaS-based support contract for a large customer

experience.description: Development, enhancement and functional support of financial ERP applications for global industrial and retail customers (names by request).
highlights: Owned functional design and development of financial modules, reports and localisation features for global industrial and retail customers

experience.description: Custom financial software development for energy retail, utilities and logistics customers.
highlights: Delivered 3 systems in three years: two request-payment (treasury) systems and a forwarding-management system integrated with CRM, transport management and 1C

experience.description: Oracle E-Business Suite financials implementation for a state telecom holding (the project went live on time).
highlights: Took part in the Oracle EBS financials implementation (GL, CE, TR, AP) for a state telecom holding; project went live on time
Wrote functional designs, tested modules, trained junior consultants and key users

experience.description: Own AI-agent and automation projects, all running in production; used in the daily delivery routine, not only as a demonstration of technology.
highlights: Built omb-agent, a multi-agent platform (LangGraph, RAG, MCP skills) that runs my own workflows across messaging, scheduling and data pipelines
Telegram assistant and data pipelines: LLM digests, Gmail and Google Photos integrations
Self-hosted Kubernetes platform with CI/CD, Cloudflare Access and observability

items: Oracle ERP Cloud / Oracle Fusion Applications
